common.title: Joint Threat Response
common.line: States hit by the same class of incident pool attribution, intelligence and response: a joint cyber command with real-time telemetry sharing that the Union is invited into, or a biosurveillance pact with binding sample-sharing and a standing investigation mandate.

common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

common.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
common.line: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion.

notable.title: Catastrophic Biological Incident
notable.line: A global biological outbreak caused by a pathogen designed with AI.

notable.title: Washington Takes the Labs
notable.line: The United States takes its frontier laboratories under direct state control.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.
